reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read Moses' Numbers 31 wrath as zeal for Israel's welfare rather than cruelty, distinct from the personal meekness Numbers 12:3 describes.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Wells presses the plain reading that ordering the massacre of Midianite boys and non-virgin women is incompatible with being called the meekest man on earth.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.
